content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Kendrapara UCB Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 25-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Kendrapara UCB to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Kendrapara Urban Cooperative Bank (Kendrapara UCB) for filling various banking positions in Odisha.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under Kendrapara UCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 14 vacancies available for Manager and Assistant Manager posts in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Manager and Assistant Manager in the banking sector located in Kendrapara, Odisha.

faq.question: Q4. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 02-10-2026 and concludes on 25-10-2026. Candidates must apply within this timeframe.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university with the required percentage of marks and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Manager post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Manager post is between 21 and 42 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved category candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the Assistant Manager post?
faq.answer: The Assistant Manager post receives a salary scale of Rs. 5200-20200 with a Grade Pay of Rs. 2400/-.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for General candidates?
faq.answer: General (Unreserved) category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 750/- online.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises an Online Written Test followed by a Viva-voce Test for qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for Kendrapara UCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official website at https://www.kendraparaucb.bank.in and following the registration instructions.
